candidate.answerReason: With the usual number-line convention, two units to the left of zero represents -2.

methods.label: Direction and distance
methods.explanation: The negative direction is to the left of the origin. A point 2 units from the origin in that direction represents -2.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 correspondence between signed numbers and positions on a number line.
